### postprocessor

``` python
def postprocessor(
    fname, # Full path of the zipped file in local storage
    action, # One of "download" (file doesn't exist and will download),
    # "update" (file is outdated and will download), and
    # "fetch" (file exists and is updated so no download).
    pup, # The instance of Pooch that called the processor function.
): # The full path to the unzipped file. (Return the same fname is your
processor doesn't modify the file).
```

*Post-processing hook to process the downloaded v1 catalog file.*

Postprocessing steps are: 1. unzip to CSV 2. load CSV into pandas 3.
save as parquet file.

This time, at the next read, the performance is much increased due to
reading the parquet file instead of loading the CSV file every time.

def normalize_tile_id(

necessary.*

### get_cached_tile_ids

``` python
def get_cached_tile_ids(): # Sorted tile_ids whose subframe image is present in the local cache.
```

*Reverse-map the local subframe cache to the tile_ids available
offline.*

Scans the pooch tiles cache (`pooch.os_cache("p4tools/tiles")`), where
each file is named `<md5(url)>-<subject>.jpg`, and maps it back to its
tile_id via
[`get_tile_urls`](https://michaelaye.github.io/p4tools/io.html#get_tile_urls).
Only files whose name matches `pooch.utils.unique_file_name` of the
looked-up URL are counted, so stray files are ignored.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/michaelaye/p4tools/blob/main/p4tools/io.py#L449"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### cached_tile_ids_with_markings

``` python
def cached_tile_ids_with_markings(
    kind:str='any', # "fan"/"blotch": tiles with at least one fan / blotch.
    # "any": tiles with at least one fan OR blotch (default).
    # "both": tiles with at least one fan AND at least one blotch.
    version:NoneType=None, # Catalog version to check against (defaults to the session version).
): # Sorted cached tile_ids that satisfy `kind`.
```

*Cached tile_ids that have fan and/or blotch markings in the catalog.*

<a
href="https://github.com/michaelaye/p4tools/blob/main/p4tools/io.py#L480"

### sample_cached_tile_ids

``` python
def sample_cached_tile_ids(
    n:int=1, # Number of tile_ids to draw (without replacement).
    kind:NoneType=None, # If given, restrict to cached tiles that have those markings (see
    # `cached_tile_ids_with_markings`). None (default) samples any cached tile.
    seed:NoneType=None, # Seed for reproducible sampling.
    version:NoneType=None, # Catalog version for the `kind` filter (defaults to the session version).
): # `n` tile_ids randomly drawn from the (optionally filtered) cached set.
```

*Random sample of tile_ids whose subframe image is locally cached.*

plt.imshow(get_subframe_by_tile_id(tile_id))

``` python
# set_catalog_version changes the module default
assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3.1"
set_catalog_version("v3")
assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3"
set_catalog_version("v3.1")  # restore
assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3.1"
```

``` python
# catalog_version context manager temporarily overrides and restores the default
assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3.1"
with catalog_version("v1"):
    assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v1"
assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3.1"  # restored after context exit
```

``` python
# catalog_version context manager restores even on exception
try:
    with catalog_version("v3"):
        assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3"
        raise RuntimeError("simulated error")
except RuntimeError:
    pass
assert _DEFAULT_VERSION == "v3.1"  # restored despite exception
```

``` python
# _resolve_version returns explicit version when given, default otherwise, and normalises .0 suffixes
assert _resolve_version("v1") == "v1"
assert _resolve_version("v1.0") == "v1"
assert _resolve_version("v3.0") == "v3"
assert _resolve_version("v3.1") == "v3.1"
assert _resolve_version(None) == "v3.1"
```

## Convenience joiners

Tiny helpers that left-join an obsid-keyed dataframe with metafull (MY,
L_s) or
[`get_region_names`](https://michaelaye.github.io/p4tools/io.html#get_region_names)
(`roi_name`).
